generate_def_from_lib: run gen-def.py with a usrsctp.lib file to generate a Windows module definition file listing exported usrsctp functions
extract_usrsctp_symbols: run gen-def.py against a .lib file to extract all usrsctp_* function symbols using dumpbin
check_dumpbin_availability: run gen-def.py to verify dumpbin is on PATH before extracting symbols from a library file
parse_linker_member_output: run gen-def.py to parse dumpbin linker member output and filter usrsctp function names with regex
review_gen_def_script: review gen-def.py to understand how it extracts usrsctp symbols from a Windows .lib file
